resources.string: One tap tells your loved ones you\'re OK
Add a loved one, then tap Start
No loved ones added yet. If you miss 3 check-ins, the app will only suggest dialling 112.
Mark one person as emergency — they get the phone call. Without one, the app suggests 112.

How it works:
1. You get a notification: tap “I'm OK”.
2. Tapped → logged on your phone, nothing is sent.
3. Not tapped → your loved ones get a WhatsApp message (or an SMS if WhatsApp isn't set up or fails).
4. 3 missed in a row → your emergency contact is called.
5. Tap any time later → everything resets and loved ones are told you're OK.
6. Battery at 15% → loved ones are told, because a dead phone can't send alerts.
Tap “I\'m OK” so we don\'t alert your loved ones.
Missed %1$d of %2$d. Your loved ones were messaged — tap “I\'m OK” now.
You missed %1$d check-ins in a row.
You missed %1$d check-ins and no emergency contact is set. If this is an emergency, tap to open the dialer with 112.
JeevanPulse alert: %1$s has not responded to their safety check-in. Please call or check on them.
JeevanPulse: %1$s has now checked in. Everything is OK.
Tapped I\'m OK — loved ones told all is well
SMS not sent — no loved ones or no SMS permission
Phone blocked auto-call to %1$s — tap-to-call shown
Logged. Your loved ones won\'t be alerted.
Please allow SMS, Phone and Notifications so JeevanPulse can protect you.
Alert sent: %1$d on WhatsApp, %2$d by SMS
Could not reach %1$s (WhatsApp and SMS both failed)
JeevanPulse: %1$s\'s phone battery is low (%2$d%%). If it switches off, safety alerts can\'t be sent. Please remind them to charge it.

Free WhatsApp alerts use the CallMeBot service. %1$s does this once, on THEIR phone:

1. Tap “Setup guide” and save the CallMeBot number shown there.
2. On WhatsApp, send it exactly: I allow callmebot to send me messages
3. They get a reply with an API key. Type that key below.
4. Tap “Send test”: they should get a WhatsApp message.

If WhatsApp fails or there is no internet, JeevanPulse sends an SMS instead.
JeevanPulse test: you will get WhatsApp alerts about %1$s here ✓
WhatsApp failed. Check the key and the internet connection.
